overview_description.description:
AudioBeta developed web-based applications that helps bands communicate with fans and make informed decisions when planning tours.

AudioBeta was a U.S.-based company that was founded in 2006 by Altay Guvench, Keith Fahlgren, and two other co-founders and backed by Y-Combinator.
